title: Moment
description: A point in a source's history that an answer cites. Media links are signed, expire like event links and carry the caller's grants; they are signed afresh every time the message is read.

label.description: What happened, in one short sentence.

snapshot_url.description: Masked snapshot; null when the moment has no picture (a sound) or the caller has no video grant for it.

clip_url.description: Signed HLS playlist around the moment.

event_id.description: The event this moment comes from, when it is one.
